correctness.rationale: The quantifier is every real Banach space with symmetric Birkhoff orthogonality and every α,β>0. For any unit x⊥B y, symmetric orthogonality also gives y⊥B x; hence ||βx−αy||≥β and ≥α, while ||αx+βy||≤α+β. Subtraction and division by α gives min(1,β/α). The hexagonal unit norm N(s,t)=max(|s|,|t|,|s−t|) has a complete edge/vertex classification under its six-point isometry group. On an edge x=(1,u), y=(0,±1), reverse witnesses t−us or us−t; at x=(1,0), y=(v,1), the functional s−vt annihilates y and t annihilates x. These exhaust unit Birkhoff pairs and prove symmetry; x=(1,0),y=(0,−1) attains (α+β−max(α,β))/α for all parameters. Checked arithmetic and sign conventions against actual RESULT.md and verify.py. Neither finitely sampled α/β nor the finite checker is used to prove all parameters.
residual_risks: The exact equality formula concerns this hexagon, not every Radon plane.
The sharper β/α branch is not asserted for nonsymmetric Birkhoff orthogonality.
